title: ಚೆನ್ನಮಲ್ಲಿಕಾರ್ಜುನ
verse:
ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಮನೆಯ ಮಾಡಿ
ಮೃಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಂಜಿದೊಡೆಂತಯ್ಯ?
bhavartha: A life built on truth cannot be shaken by fear. Akka Mahadevi asks us to live with courage once we have chosen a higher path.
poet_bio: A 12th-century mystic poet whose vachanas gave Kannada literature a fearless voice of devotion and independence.

title: ಕಾಯಕವೇ ಕೈಲಾಸ
verse:
ಉಳ್ಳವರು ಶಿವಾಲಯ ಮಾಡುವರು
ನಾನೇನು ಮಾಡಲಿ ಬಡವನಯ್ಯ?
bhavartha: Basavanna turns devotion into daily work. The body, the job, and honest effort become a temple.
poet_bio: A philosopher, social reformer, and poet from the 12th century who made spiritual thought direct and democratic.

title: ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ
verse:
ಓ ನನ್ನ ಚೇತನ
ಆಗು ನೀ ಅನಿಕೇತನ
bhavartha: Kuvempu invites the mind to grow beyond narrow walls and become universal in sympathy, thought, and action.
poet_bio: Kuppali Venkatappa Puttappa, known as Kuvempu, was a major modern Kannada poet and Jnanpith awardee.

title: ನಾಡ ಲೀಲಾ
verse:
ನಾನು ಬಡವಿ ಆತ ಬಡವ
ಒಲವೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಬದುಕು
bhavartha: Bendre makes love feel like wealth. The poem celebrates tenderness as the real measure of a life.
poet_bio: Da. Ra. Bendre was a lyrical Kannada poet whose work blended folk rhythm, philosophy, and modern feeling.

title: ಬಾಗಿಲನು ತೆರೆದು
bhavartha: Kanakadasa turns longing into song, asking for a doorway into grace and equality.
poet_bio: A saint-poet and composer whose devotional songs remain central to Kannada cultural memory.

title: ಆದಿಪುರಾಣ
bhavartha: Pampa's classical imagination connects human greatness with discipline, ethics, and inner refinement.
poet_bio: Known as Adikavi, Pampa is one of the earliest and most influential poets of classical Kannada literature.
